items.name: essential-dialog
items.title: Essential Dialog
items.description: A native <dialog> that morphs out of its own trigger and back into it, driven by GSAP Flip. Drop-in API parity with shadcn/ui Dialog: Trigger, Content, Header, Title, Description, Footer, Close and `render` composition. Drag it anywhere to dismiss. Every visual value is a CSS variable and nothing inside imports from components/ui, so the content stays entirely yours.
items.author: Anthony Cifuentes
items.docs: Trigger geometry is the origin of the animation, so the trigger must be a real DOM node — compose it with `render={<Button />}`. Size the dialog through --essential-dialog-width rather than a max-w-* class: the surface's width is animated inline and a max-width would clamp the morph. Pass `debug` to outline every layer and log the boxes, coverage and drag thresholds the morph is built from.
